description: This file defines an internal C# class 'SimpleGenerator' implementing the 'IStreamGenerator' interface within the Orleans streaming provider framework. It generates a configurable number of stream events, producing one event per poll, with methods for configuration and reading events.

classes.name: SimpleGenerator
classes.description: Implements a simple stream generator that produces a fixed number of events, one per poll, for Orleans streaming.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the generator with options extracted from the provided generator configuration.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate and return up to maxCount events, until the configured number of events has been generated.

methods.name: TryGenerateBatch
methods.description: Generates a single batch event if the sequence has not reached the total configured events.
